item.goetyarcana.soul_burst_focus.info: A focus torn from the space between worlds. Hold it long enough and you can hear something breathing on the other side.
effect.goetyarcana.execution.description: After 5 seconds: normal enemies die instantly, elites lose 10% max health, bosses lose 20% max health (ignores boss damage caps).
death.attack.voidWave: %1$s was torn apart by a void scythe wave
death.attack.voidWave.player: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's void scythe wave
effect.goetyarcana.void_eye.description: +20% reload speed and arrow velocity per stack, up to 3 stacks. Removed when switching weapons.
effect.goetyarcana.bleed.description: Lose 2 HP per second for 6 seconds.
item.goetyarcana.void_scythe.wip: The model is currently WIP and may be revised later.
effect.goetyarcana.void_explosion.descri: Explodes around the carrier after 4 seconds.
item.goetyarcana.void_scythe.lore: A pair of scythes dragged out of an End rift, their blades still shaped like the tear they came from. They say the void whispers when you swing them.
item.goetyarcana.void_crossbow.lore: Only one line about the first Void Crossbow survives: an eye that would not close was set into its stock. It does not aim - it simply sends what it sees into the void.
item.goetyarcana.void_crossbow_bolt.lore: Liquid void poured into a shaft and left to set. Heavier than iron, and hungrier.
item.goetyarcana.bramble_bind_focus.info: A thorned seed carried back from the deep wilds. Buried, it simply waits - until something steps near, and a ring of brambles rises from the soil and never lets go. Old wild witches say a wild staff makes the brambles spread wider and hold longer, and a wild robe makes the thorns weep poison.
effect.goetyarcana.entangled.description: Bound by wild vines: cannot move, use items or cast.
effect.goetyarcana.vine_poison.descripti: The venom of wild brambles. It bites deeper every second and no healing can touch a poisoned creature - the undead cannot shrug it off either.
item.goetyarcana.void_rupture_focus.info: The hunger of the void needs somewhere to go. Swallow a bursting seed, pull a creeper out of nothing - it does not hiss. It only looks at you, then appears beside your enemy.
effect.goetyarcana.void_blast_curse.desc: The mark left by a void blast that failed to kill: ordinary creatures cling to a single point of life, while bosses only make the next void creeper hit harder.
item.goetyarcana.void_shard.info: A fragment peeled out of a void creeper. Heavier than it looks and colder than it looks - hold it, and you can still feel a little hunger shifting inside.
effect.goetyarcana.rooted.description: Pinned by wild vines: teleportation is blocked.
item.goetyarcana.enchanted_void_creeper_: Enchanted Void Creeper Servant Spawn Egg
item.goetyarcana.void_creeper_head.info: Its eyes are shut. The void took everything else and left the face - hang it on a wall, and it will still seem to be watching someone.
item.goetyarcana.void_amulet.info: A fang strung on red cord. It passes on a share of what the void grants you - and it remembers to pull you back from the edge.
message.goetyarcana.amulet.rescued: Void Amulet: pulled you back from the void.
message.goetyarcana.amulet.missing: You are not carrying a Void Amulet.
effect.goetyarcana.void_aegis.descriptio: The void takes the blow for you; the aegis fades with time - full immunity at first, gone after ten minutes.
message.goetyarcana.amulet.aegis: Void Aegis: the amulet answered your death.
effect.goetyarcana.bomb_curse.descriptio: What is left after a void creeper blast you survived: all damage taken +40%, explosion damage +80%.
